notes: Fixed: new versions now reach the installed app (before, the offline helper never noticed an update, so old screens could keep showing).
Offline check now says when a new version is waiting and the app needs closing and reopening.
Paint: the pointer is now a clear ring (white with a black edge) showing where and how big the brush is, so it can be seen on any colour.
Numbers: 11 Year 1 activities (counting, one more or less, number bonds, adding, taking away, doubles, halves). Tap the answer; each round of 10 earns 1 to 3 stars and the best is remembered.
Phonics: three activities using only the sounds ticked as learned (first sound, build the word, read and match). No audio yet.
Paint: free drawing that fills the screen, 12 colours, 3 brush sizes, rubber, undo and clear. Save to a gallery, reopen to keep painting, delete pictures.
Write: a simple note with big text in the Andika font, 4 text sizes and 10 colours. It saves by itself.
Games: Noughts and Crosses, Connect 4, Snakes and Ladders and Ludo, against people or computer players (levels 1 to 10), with house rules you can change before each game.
She can make her own game players (a person or a computer) in Games.
A thinking icon shows when the computer is working out its move.
Fixed a stray 'false' on the home screen, and similar stray text in some grown-ups screens.
First version: home screen with six app tiles (apps coming soon).
Grown-ups area behind a sum: her name and picture, phonics sounds learned, game players, backup and restore, offline check.
Works offline once opened; sound button; keyboard and gamepad navigation.
